name: Aadhaar Card
short_description: Aadhaar is an identity number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI).
importance: Used for identity verification where accepted.
May be requested for government services and welfare schemes, subject to applicable rules.
Helps residents access Aadhaar online services.
who_needs_it: Residents who wish to enrol for Aadhaar.
People who need to update their Aadhaar details.
documents_required: Proof of identity accepted by UIDAI.
Proof of address accepted by UIDAI, where required.
Other supporting documents depending on the enrolment or update request.
application_steps: Visit the official UIDAI website.
Check the current enrolment or update requirements.
Book an appointment if available for the selected service.
Visit an authorised Aadhaar enrolment centre when in-person verification is required.
Keep the enrolment or update acknowledgement and track the status.
issuing_authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
application_mode: Online services and authorised enrolment or update centres, depending on the service

name: PAN Card
short_description: Permanent Account Number (PAN) is used for tax-related identification and specified financial transactions.
importance: Used for income-tax-related services.
Required for certain financial and banking transactions under applicable rules.
May be requested for financial applications and records.
who_needs_it: Individuals who need a PAN for tax or financial purposes.
People who need to correct, update or replace their PAN records.
documents_required: Proof of identity as specified for the selected application type.
Proof of address as specified for the selected application type.
Proof of date of birth where required.
Photograph, signature or supporting declarations where applicable.
application_steps: Visit the official Income Tax Department website or an authorised PAN service provider.
Select the applicable PAN application service.
Check the current application form and document requirements.
Submit the application and complete the required verification.
Track the application using the acknowledgement details.
issuing_authority: Income Tax Department, Government of India
application_mode: Online through authorised services; availability depends on the application type

name: Voter ID / Elector Photo Identity Card
short_description: A voter identity card is associated with electoral registration and helps identify an enrolled elector.
importance: Supports electoral identity verification.
Allows eligible citizens to participate in elections when their name is included in the electoral roll.

who_needs_it: Eligible Indian citizens who want to register as voters.
Registered voters who need to correct or update their details.
documents_required: Recent photograph, where required.
Age or date-of-birth proof accepted by the Election Commission.
Address proof accepted for electoral registration.
Additional information or documents required by the selected form.
application_steps: Open the Election Commission of India's Voters' Services Portal.
Register or sign in as required.
Select the appropriate service for new registration or correction.
Complete the form and upload the requested documents.
Track the application and respond to any verification request.
issuing_authority: Election Commission of India and the relevant electoral registration authorities
application_mode: Online application with verification where required

name: Indian Passport
short_description: An Indian passport is an official travel document issued to eligible Indian citizens.
importance: Required for international travel, subject to destination and travel rules.
Serves as an official identity and nationality document.
May be useful as supporting identity or address evidence where accepted.
who_needs_it: Indian citizens planning international travel.
Applicants seeking a fresh passport or passport reissue.
documents_required: Documents proving identity and date of birth as applicable.
Address proof specified by Passport Seva.
Existing passport for a reissue application, where applicable.
Additional documents for minors or special cases.
application_steps: Register on the official Passport Seva portal.
Choose fresh passport or reissue, as applicable.
Complete and submit the online application.
Pay the applicable fee and schedule an appointment.
Visit the selected Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra with the required original documents.
Track the application status online.
issuing_authority: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
application_mode: Online application followed by an appointment and verification

name: Birth Certificate
short_description: A birth certificate is an official record of a person's birth registered with the competent civil registration authority.

who_needs_it: Parents registering a child's birth.
People who need an official copy of a registered birth record.
Applicants who need to correct or register an eligible birth record.
documents_required: Hospital or birth-facility record, where applicable.
Parent or informant identity details.
Address and birth details requested by the local registration authority.
Additional evidence for delayed registration or corrections, as required.
application_steps: Identify the competent registrar or local civil registration authority.
Check whether birth registration or certificate download is available online in the relevant state or locality.
Submit the prescribed form and supporting records.
Complete any additional verification required for delayed registration or corrections.
Collect or download the certificate when it becomes available.
issuing_authority: Competent Registrar of Births and Deaths or relevant local authority
application_mode: Online or through the local registration authority, depending on the state and service

name: Income Certificate
short_description: An income certificate records income details as assessed or certified by the competent authority.
importance: May be required for income-based welfare schemes and scholarships.

who_needs_it: Students applying for eligible scholarships.
Families applying for income-based benefits.

Address or residence proof.
Income evidence such as salary records, employer details or other accepted records.

Review the official eligibility and document checklist.
Submit the application through the linked state portal or designated office.
Complete verification and track the application.

Submit the application to the designated authority.

application_mode: Online or offline, depending on the state
